# Assay — daily-sheet audit template (plain English, no YAML).

# Persona: auditor (checks the sheet against a compliance standard)
# One [CHECK] block per thing you look for. Fill every field.

[CHECK]
check_id = CHECK-001
what_is_this_check_for = Passport photo attached
what_to_look_at = photo column, one photo per applicant row
expected_value_or_rule = no blank
when_it_fails_say = No passport photo for this applicant
machine_can_check = yes
column_name = photo
example_that_passes = applicant row A1 with a photo in the cell
example_that_fails = applicant row A2 with an empty photo cell

[CHECK]
check_id = CHECK-002
what_is_this_check_for = QA score at least passing threshold
what_to_look_at = qa_score column
expected_value_or_rule = >= 60
when_it_fails_say = QA score below the passing threshold
machine_can_check = yes
column_name = qa_score
example_that_passes = a row with qa_score 95
example_that_fails = a row with qa_score 42

[CHECK]
check_id = CHECK-003
what_is_this_check_for = Face is legible on the passport photo
what_to_look_at = the embedded passport image
expected_value_or_rule = a clear, unobstructed face photo
when_it_fails_say = Passport photo not usable
machine_can_check = no
human_review_note = Reviewer must open the extracted image and confirm.
example_that_passes = a clear frontal face photo
example_that_fails = a blurry or blocked photo
